firmware.note: v0.1.9 (built 2026-11-24): sleep-rate correction (deep-sleep timer runs ~1.07% fast; durations now scaled 1.010x so wakes land at ~03:00), highlight underline in the handwriting style (schedule v4 carries the span; straight stroke + dithered echo, toggleable), quote hold, manual date, and an app-like settings page on the setup network (display settings, hold, date). Serif ladder tops at 36pt (NotoSerif42 dropped to fit the OTA slot; all quotes host-verified to fit). Wake order and paint-first behavior are exactly v0.1.8. The firmware channel reads only version + url; sha256/sizeBytes recorded for verification.
